name: Discord Wastes: Warfront
summary: A violent frontline where Muramite outposts clash with Discord manifestations.
description: The Discord Wastes Warfront is a chaotic battlefield where Muramite observation outposts attempt to contain or repel Discord manifestations emerging from deeper rifts. Arcane storms, unstable terrain, and constant skirmishes define the area. Muramite forces maintain fortified barricades and arcane stabilizers, while Discord entities surge unpredictably. The Warfront is extremely dangerous and represents the last line of Muramite control before the Wastes fully consume the land.
